ingredient.water.name: Water
ingredient.water.description: From the pump in the yard. Costs nothing, cures nothing, fills a bottle.
ingredient.grain_alcohol.name: Grain Alcohol
ingredient.grain_alcohol.description: Rectified spirit. Warms the throat, loosens the tongue, and keeps a tincture from spoiling.
ingredient.sugar_syrup.name: Sugar Syrup
ingredient.sugar_syrup.description: Simple syrup to make the medicine go down.
ingredient.peppermint_oil.name: Oil of Peppermint
ingredient.peppermint_oil.description: A few drops hide a multitude of sins.
ingredient.gentian.name: Gentian Root
ingredient.gentian.description: Fiercely bitter. Customers are convinced that anything this unpleasant must be working.
ingredient.capsicum.name: Capsicum
ingredient.capsicum.description: Red pepper. A warming sensation the customer can feel, at the cost of a penny.
ingredient.aloe.name: Bitter Aloes
ingredient.aloe.description: A powerful purgative. The customer will certainly feel that something has happened.
ingredient.laudanum.name: Laudanum
ingredient.laudanum.description: Tincture of opium. Soothes every complaint, and brings the customer back for more.
ingredient.morphine.name: Morphine
ingredient.morphine.description: The pure alkaloid of opium. A little goes a very long way.
ingredient.coca_extract.name: Fluid Extract of Coca
ingredient.coca_extract.description: The fashionable new stimulant. Banishes fatigue and melancholy alike.
ingredient.calomel.name: Calomel
ingredient.calomel.description: Mercurous chloride, the physician's standby. It purges, and it lingers in the body.
ingredient.fowlers_solution.name: Fowler's Solution
ingredient.fowlers_solution.description: A respectable arsenical tonic. Brightens the complexion, for a while.
ingredient.sulfuric_acid_dilute.name: Dilute Sulphuric Acid
ingredient.sulfuric_acid_dilute.descript: A sour tang that tells the customer the microbes are being killed.
ingredient.acetanilide.name: Acetanilide
ingredient.acetanilide.description: A new coal-tar remedy for headache and fever. Hard on the heart.
ingredient.heroin.name: Heroin
ingredient.heroin.description: A new and heroic remedy for coughs, said to be free of morphine's drawbacks.
ingredient.aspirin.name: Aspirin
ingredient.aspirin.description: A new analgesic that actually relieves pain without killing anybody.
process.simple_mix.name: Simple Mixture
process.steep.name: Steeping
process.steep.description: Let the botanicals steep in spirit for a stronger, more bitter tincture.
process.percolate.name: Percolation
process.percolate.description: Drip spirit slowly through the drugs for a thorough extraction.
unlock.second_still.name: A Second Still
unlock.second_still.description: Two brews a month instead of one.
unlock.percolator.name: The Percolator
unlock.percolator.description: A glass percolator for stronger extractions.
unlock.newspaper_ads.name: Newspaper Advertising
unlock.newspaper_ads.description: With savings in hand and a testimonial to print, the papers will take your money.
unlock.doctor_title.name: "Doctor"
unlock.doctor_title.description: A title for your name and your labels, earned or otherwise.
unlock.third_still.name: A Third Still
unlock.third_still.description: The back room is becoming a works.
event.grateful_letter.title: A Grateful Letter
event.grateful_letter.body: A customer writes that your tonic restored her to health after three doctors failed. She would be honoured to see her words in print.
event.diploma_mill.title: A Medical Education, by Post
event.diploma_mill.body: A circular from a 'college of eclectic medicine' in Ohio offers a diploma for fifty dollars, no attendance required.
event.sanitary_inspector.title: The Sanitary Inspector
event.sanitary_inspector.body: A man from the Board of Health is looking at your back room and frowning. He mentions that his inspections can take a very long time.
event.sanitary_inspector.choice.pay_fee: Pay him three dollars for his trouble.
event.rival_shop_opens.title: A Rival on the Corner
event.rival_shop_opens.body: A new druggist has opened two doors down, with a window full of bottles very like yours.
event.rival_shop_opens.choice.spread_rum: Let it be known that his stock is adulterated.
timeline.antifebrin.headline: New Coal-Tar Remedy for Fever
timeline.antifebrin.body: German chemists offer acetanilide, sold as Antifebrin, for headache and fever.
timeline.ladies_journal_ad_ban.headline: Ladies' Journal Bars Patent Medicine Advertising
timeline.ladies_journal_ad_ban.body: A leading women's magazine announces it will no longer print advertisements for patent medicines.
timeline.rural_free_delivery.headline: Free Mail Delivery Comes to the Countryside
timeline.rural_free_delivery.body: The Post Office begins delivering letters and parcels directly to farms.
timeline.heroin_marketed.headline: A Heroic New Cough Remedy
timeline.heroin_marketed.body: A German firm begins marketing heroin for coughs and consumption.
timeline.aspirin_marketed.headline: New Analgesic Registered
timeline.aspirin_marketed.body: A remedy for pain and fever, aspirin, is registered and offered to physicians.
timeline.poison_squad.headline: The 'Poison Squad' Sits Down to Dinner
timeline.poison_squad.body: Government chemists are feeding young volunteers common preservatives to see what they do to the body.
timeline.great_american_fraud.headline: "The Great American Fraud"
timeline.great_american_fraud.body: A national weekly begins a series exposing the contents of popular patent medicines. Your trade is the subject.
timeline.pure_food_and_drug_act.headline: Congress Passes the Pure Food and Drug Act
timeline.pure_food_and_drug_act.body: From the first of January next, alcohol, opium, morphine, cocaine and other drugs must be declared on the label.
background.druggist.name: The Druggist
background.druggist.description: A trained hand in the laboratory, with modest savings and no gift for publicity.
background.showman.name: The Showman
background.showman.description: A born talker with a thin wallet and a casual attitude to measurement.
